main_text.head: TYPOGRAPHVS
LECTORI.
main_text.p: Accipe,lector,Commentarios in Pindarum, quos tibi nūc primum offero, quibus loci difficiles explanantur,hi-storiæ & fabulæ quas Poëta obiter attingit, quibúsq; non cognitis subinde lectori hærendum esset,fusè & dilucidè explicantur, cum perpetua ἀναλύσει[?] argumentorum, & digressionū, quibus hoc poema, nequaquā humi repens, sed dithyrambico more assurgens, refertum est, atque a-deò insignium sententiarum, quibus tanquam stellis or-natum& distinctum est,ita ut qui hos Commentarios ha-buerit,ad grauissimum nec ita peruium authorem intelli-gendum, nihil propemodum sit desideraturus. vale.

page.notes: Faint show-through of the title "COMMENTARII ABSOLVTISSIMI" at the top right and of other text lower on the page; not transcribed. The Greek word after "perpetua" is uncertain and marked [?]. Long s has been written as plain s throughout. The printed "hi-/storiæ" is kept as hyphenated across the line end.
